description: 1. Agent reads task_brief.txt and locates the two raw data files. 2. Agent navigates to skills/newsletter-growth-hacker/scripts/ and imports GrowthTracker from analytics_engine.py. 3. Agent parses subscriber_history.csv (stripping whitespace from headers and values), calls tracker.add_period() for all 6 rows with the correct signature (period, total_subscribers, new_subscribers, lost_subscribers, sources_dict where sources={'organic':..., 'referral':..., 'paid':...}). 4. Agent calls tracker.project_growth(4) to get exactly 4 projections. 5. Agent parses q1_campaign_metrics.json, noting the 'Spam_Complaints' key (underscore variant) must be mapped to the spam_complaints parameter of NewsletterMetrics. Agent constructs NewsletterMetrics with all int-cast fields and calls engine.create_report('FinTech Weekly Q1 2026', metrics). 6. Agent imports SubjectLineGenerator from content_optimizer.py and calls generator.create_ab_test(topic='市场波动中的理财策略', goal='提升打开率', variants=4), extracting the 'variants' list from the result. 7. Agent assembles all three outputs into a dict with keys growth_projections, campaign_report, ab_test_variants and saves as quarterly_review.json.
